behavior.test: refreshes the selected organisation once without overwriting a newer sibling connection

limitations: Native actual XeroClientService/Axios/emulator HTTP; not live Xero or browser evidence.
Private in-memory secret provider; disconnect lock and database seams mocked, no cross-process concurrency proof.
Sibling update is deliberately interleaved after client creation and before refresh, not a real simultaneous database transaction.
No product fix required; initial failed test runs corrected fixture assertions, not a production regression red.
